name: llmchat-cli
description: Personal experimental CLI for integrating web-based LLM chat interfaces and providers into automated workflows, including MCP servers, scheduled tasks, and any system that can invoke a command-line tool.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --extension .ts --include "src/**/*.ts" --exclude-after-remap --check-coverage --lines 100 --functions 100 --branches 100 npm run test:unit
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run coverage
